basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is filling 1 post of Research Associate - Research in the Department of Medical Science and Technology. The post is in the research project "Portable Intraoral Multispectral Imager for Cancer screening", sponsored by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The tenure is 06 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier, and the consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 61,000 per month. age_limit.details: The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Candidates must possess either of the following: | i) Ph.D. / MD / MS / MDS or equivalent degree, OR ii) 3 years of research, teaching, design, and development experience after MVSc / M.Pharm / ME / M.Tech, with at least one research paper published in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

how_to_apply: IIT Kharagpur has invited applications through online mode for this assignment. The notice does not print the portal address; it was published on the IIT Kharagpur ERP system. Applications must be submitted by 14 November 2026.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy)
Portable Intraoral Multispectral Imager for Cancer screening (Project Code – R/IIC)
Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
06 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to Rs. 61,000 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
35 years (age as on last date of advertisement)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess either of the following: i) Ph.D. / MD / MS / MDS or equivalent degree, OR ii) 3 years of research, teaching, design, and development experience after MVSc / M.Pharm / ME / M.Tech, with at least one research paper published in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Expertise in Biomedical optical device development, basics of image analysis and statistical evaluation for medical data. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate - Research will receive a consolidated compensation of up to Rs. 61,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance. This is a temporary assignment in a purely time bound research project. The tenure is 06 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Research Associate - Research
content_sections.text: IIT Kharagpur has invited applications through online mode for this assignment. The notice does not print the portal address; it was published on the IIT Kharagpur ERP system. Applications must be submitted by 14 November 2026. The application fee is Rs. 0 for all categories. The notice gives the following bank account for depositing the application fee through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking: The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Research Associate - Research under Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/IIC/2026/102.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. / MD / MS / MDS or equivalent degree, or 3 years of research, teaching, design, and development experience after MVSc / M.Pharm / ME / M.Tech with at least one research paper published in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 61,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications are invited through online mode until 14 November 2026. Any fee transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary assignment in a purely time bound research project, for 06 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which agency funds this IIT Kharagpur research project?
faq.answer: The project "Portable Intraoral Multispectral Imager for Cancer screening" is sponsored by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

faq.question: Q10. What experience is desired for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The desired experience is expertise in Biomedical optical device development, basics of image analysis and statistical evaluation for medical data.
